summary: Produced the definitive mutation plan + API for creating native Revit elements. Established (with hard evidence) that adding an element = insert its three records (seq101 ElementHeader / seq102 object / seq103 rep) into SAVE UNIT 0 of the existing Partitions/N (unit 0 IS the host document — its ids == Global/ElemTable ids exactly; units 1..k are embedded family documents, copied verbatim), append one 40-byte ElemRec (id = watermark+1 from ElemTable footer IdentifierSource.m_last), and record the save (new DocumentIncrement row, new History episode, BasicFileInfo GUID). No new save unit and no new partition stream (N = current major increment - 1; the stream is rewritten wholesale). SOLVED the seq-102/103 record stamp = adler32(u16 class_id + object bytes), 287,441/287,441 records. Decoded 19 complete real specimens (level, grid, wall, door+cut-clone symbol+family, wall type, room; MEP: panelboard instance/symbol/family/SketchPlane host, circuit, receptacle, space, ConnectorElem) as annotated JSON with labelled ElemRecs and full reference closures. Wrote the field-by-field recipe for a new SWall and a new FamilyInstance (source of every field), the ElementHeader/ElementParents rebuild, hosting-pattern taxonomy (free/level, face-hosted via shared SketchPlane, host-cut doors needing a per-host symbol clone = phase 2), template strategy (racbasic = architectural seed, rme = MEP seed) with instantiable type/symbol id tables, and prototyped src/rvt/mutate.py (Document.add_wall / add_family_instance / diff / plan; encoder stubbed to rvt.encode.encode_record). tests/test_mutate.py: 13 passed; new elements are referentially clean against both templates.
key_findings: Save units are DOCUMENTS not saves (corrects wave-1 KNOWLEDGE): unit 0 = host document, seq-102 ids == Global/ElemTable ids EXACTLY (racbasic 8,401=8,401; rme 28,132; racadv 17,231, set equality); units 1..k = one embedded family/content document each, separator GUID = its ContentDocuments key, separator u32 counter = its record count (unit0 + sum(counters) = all 85,814 records); ElementIds unique file-wide (rme 142,174 records, 0 dupes).

Element-creation strategy [decided]: insert 3 records per element into unit 0 and re-block only unit 0, copy embedded units byte-for-byte, keep Partitions/N number; NOT a new save unit, NOT a new partition stream. N = current major increment - 1 (racbasic 16 increments -> /15, rme 15 -> /14, racadv 14 -> /13, rstbasic 22 -> /21, dach 86 -> /84,85); Revit rewrites the whole stream each save, it does not append.

SOLVED B8: seq-102/103 record u32 stamp = zlib adler32(u16 class_id + object bytes) - verified 287,441/287,441 records, 0 exceptions; sentinel stamp 1 = adler32(empty); SerializedDummy constant 0x0069003C = adler32(2c 0f). Sentinel record (id -1, psize 0) is always the LAST record of each unit's per-seq segment.

Global/DocumentIncrementTable decodes cleanly as a schema object (0x53c) + u32 0: one DocumentIncrement row per SAVE (m_majorVersion, m_userName, m_atimeStamp.m_lsb = Unix save time 2015->2025, m_greatest = max EpisodeId, m_totalEpisodes, m_incrementVersions[0].m_totalElements = partition record count 85,814, every *StreamRevision +1 per save); the same row is appended to m_localIncrements. 'first u32 = max(N)+1' is just the container count.

Global/* object streams are uniform (u16 class + object + u32 0): ElemTable footer fully decodes as m_graveyardRecs [] + m_pSource -> IdentifierSource{m_last = 1,098,947} = id watermark (class 0x96a resolved) + two false bools; new ids = watermark+1..., watermark bumped; 72% of ElemTable neighbours are id+1 so consecutive allocation looks native. Global/Latest starts as ADocument under the schema decoder (m_storedByRevitBuild = build strings per save) but diverges after 16.5 KB.

Instantiation patterns [verified]: doors 16/16 and windows 17/17 reference a per-host geometry-symbol CLONE (InstanceInfo.m_symbolId != m_masterSymbolId; unnamed FamilySymbol with cut loops) => host-cut instances are phase 2; free/face instances use symbolId == masterSymbolId (202/495 racbasic); ALL rme electrical equipment is face-hosted (m_workPlaneBased, m_hostId = a SketchPlane on the wall face) and several panels share one SketchPlane (581482-581485 on 581481) => a new panel on an equipped face needs no new SketchPlane.

Geometry reps: levels/grids/families/circuits carry SerializedDummy; walls/rooms/symbols/instances carry GElement. Instance reps are ~300-600-byte formulaic GElement{GInstance{InstanceInfo{Trf, or, symbolId}}} (clonable, implemented); wall reps are 4-56 KB solids => writer emits SerializedDummy for new walls relying on regeneration from m_geomSteps (acceptance test T2; fallback = rigid-transform of the donor GElement).

Unit-0 record order is neither id, episode nor dependency order (2,698/4,239 sampled parent refs point forward) - consistent with unordered-container iteration; treated as arbitrary (primary: insert after last record of same class; test T3), but must be identical across the three seqs.

Template strategy [decided]: racbasicsampleproject = architectural seed (levels 311/694/245423/196629/511122/515270 w/ elevations; clonable wall types = those with a straight donor instance, e.g. 232827 Interior - Partition, 198367 Wall - Timber Clad, 458927, 600634, 711906; NOT 397/54538 exterior brick - no donor); rmebasicsampleproject = MEP seed (levels 378117-378120; 32 electrical-equipment symbols incl. panelboards 455409 '400 A'/470440 family 454674 208V MLO, 480V MLO/MCB, transformers 621226-621244, switchboards 629944-8; receptacles 342652/342654 M_Duplex; 187 real circuits e.g. 469428). ProjectPhase 86961, LevelAttributes 305, GridAttributes 341 shared by both seeds.

ElementHeader (seq 101, class 0x5e5) fully understood for authoring: m_categroryId (sic; OST_Walls -2000011, doors -2000023, el.equipment -2001040, ...), m_classDef ref = seq-102 class, m_pBBox Outline, m_parents -> ElementParents dependency lists (m_deletion = {base/top level, phase, type, self}, m_appearanceParents = {30, level, type}) which must be rebuilt, never copied from the donor (donor lists contain the donor's own doors/joins).

open_questions: T2 (acceptance-critical): is a new SWall accepted with a SerializedDummy seq-103 rep (no cached GElement solid), i.e. does Revit regenerate the wall from m_geomSteps on load? Only the Windows/APS gate can answer; fallback recipe (rigid-transform donor GElement) is documented but limits length/height to the donor's.

T3: is the record order within unit 0 semantically arbitrary (unordered-container hypothesis), or must new records be class-clustered / dependency-ordered? Evidence says arbitrary; unverified in Revit.

T4: is the full save bookkeeping (new DocumentIncrement + History episode + BasicFileInfo GUID) mandatory, or does the minimal variant (only ElemTable + Partitions) load? m_incrementVersions[0].m_totalElements tracking the record count suggests the increment row matters.

Serializer (rvt.encode) does not exist yet: mutate stops at decoded-dict records; the pointer pid numbering must be re-derived per record by the encoder (documented contract), and ESEntity blobs (rme FamilyInstances with extensible storage) cannot yet be re-encoded - donors carrying ES entities should be avoided or their m_cellList ESEntityCell stripped.

Doors/windows (host-cut families) need a per-host geometry-symbol clone recipe (author or reuse an unnamed FamilySymbol carrying m_pCutLoops/m_cutDirs for the wall thickness) - phase 2, not prototyped.
Face-hosted equipment on a VIRGIN face needs a new SketchPlane element (m_oPlaneRef -> GeomRef{host wall, face tag}); prototype only reuses an existing SketchPlane.

Two racbasic exterior wall types (397, 54538) have no straight donor instance and are not clonable until a donor exists; StackedWallType out of scope.
